scope: repositories-only peer project history loading parity
cursorAgentObservations: Cursor Repositories shows multiple repository groups at once, and non-current repositories can still show their own historical chats before the user switches into them.
Each visible repository keeps its own New Agent action and row actions: completed rows expose Pin and Archive, draft rows expose Pin and Discard.
sciforgeIssueFound: SciForge peer project snapshot discovery used the active workspace writer URL for every peer project, ignoring peer.workspaceWriterUrl.
That made non-current repository history depend on the active writer being able to serve every peer path, while peer archive/delete/restore actions already used the peer writer URL.
sciforgeChanges: Changed peer sidebar session targets to use peer.workspaceWriterUrl when present, falling back to the shared workspace writer only when the peer writer is blank.
Added focused tests covering both peer writer selection and shared-writer fallback.
